tasks.title: Essay: Priorities for a university exchange programme
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write 220–260 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.text: Your class has listened to a radio discussion about how universities should prioritise funding for student exchange programmes. You have made the notes below.

promptBlocks.heading: Priorities for a university exchange programme

paragraphs: Academic preparation courses ensure students have the language and subject knowledge to succeed abroad.
Pastoral support during the exchange helps students cope with culture shock and homesickness, which can otherwise derail the experience.
Post-exchange follow-up helps students reflect on what they have learned and apply it to their future studies or career.

promptBlocks.text: Write an essay for your tutor discussing two of the priorities in your notes. You should explain which priority you think is more important for universities to invest in, giving reasons in support of your answer. You may, if you wish, make use of the opinions expressed in the discussion, but you should use your own words as far as possible.

tasks.title: Proposal: Exchange programme evaluation system
tasks.instruction: Answer one of the following questions (2–4). Write 220–260 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
Your university's exchange consortium is planning to introduce a formal evaluation system for its exchange programmes. The consortium director has invited proposals for how this system should work.

Write a proposal for the consortium director. In your proposal, you should:

• recommend what aspects of the exchange experience should be evaluated
• explain how student feedback will be collected and used
• describe how the results will be reported to partner institutions

Write your proposal.

tasks.title: Email: Responding to a partner university about exchange capacity
tasks.instruction: Answer one of the following questions (2–4). Write 220–260 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
You are the exchange programme coordinator at your university. You have received an email from a partner university's international office asking whether your institution can increase the number of incoming exchange students next year, despite limited accommodation and academic support resources.

Write an email to the partner university's international office. In your email, you should:

• acknowledge the request and explain your institution's current capacity constraints
• propose a realistic increase and outline how it could be managed
• suggest a follow-up meeting to discuss the details

Write your email.

tasks.title: Review: An exchange programme you participated in
tasks.instruction: Answer one of the following questions (2–4). Write 220–260 words in an appropriate style.

promptBlocks.heading: Reviews wanted: Exchange experiences
paragraphs: Have you taken part in a university exchange programme? We want to hear about your experience.

Write a review of the exchange programme you participated in. Describe the academic and cultural aspects of the programme, evaluate how well it prepared you for the experience, and explain whether you would recommend it to other students.
The best reviews will be published in the consortium's newsletter.
